name: World Trade Organization
summary: The intergovernmental organization that administers the multilateral trade agreements negotiated by its members, provides a forum for trade negotiations and operates a dispute settlement system.

logo.note: Logo as published on the organization's own website. A trademark of its owner, shown only to identify the organization; no partnership or endorsement is implied.

name: World Customs Organization
summary: The intergovernmental organization of customs administrations. It maintains the Harmonized Commodity Description and Coding System (HS), the six-digit product nomenclature on which national tariff schedules are built.
tradeRelevance: Customs valuation and rules of origin (technical work)

logo.note: Logo as published on the organization's own website. A trademark of its owner, shown only to identify the organization; no partnership or endorsement is implied.

name: International Maritime Organization
summary: The United Nations specialized agency responsible for the safety and security of shipping and the prevention of pollution by ships. The IMO ship identification number scheme takes its name from the organization.
tradeRelevance: IMDG Code for dangerous goods by sea

logo.note: Logo as published on the organization's own website. A trademark of its owner, shown only to identify the organization; no partnership or endorsement is implied.

name: International Chamber of Commerce
summary: A private international business organization — not an intergovernmental body. ICC publishes widely used commercial rules, including the Incoterms® rules and the Uniform Customs and Practice for Documentary Credits (UCP 600).

logo.note: Logo as published on the organization's own website. A trademark of its owner, shown only to identify the organization; no partnership or endorsement is implied.

name: International Trade Centre
summary: A joint agency of the World Trade Organization and the United Nations that supports the internationalization of small and medium-sized enterprises and publishes trade and market-access analysis tools.
tradeRelevance: Trade Map and Market Access Map tools

relations.note: The United Nations participates through UNCTAD.

name: UN Trade and Development
summary: The United Nations body dealing with trade, investment and development. It publishes the annual Review of Maritime Transport and maintains trade and maritime statistics.

logo.note: Logo as published on the organization's own website. A trademark of its owner, shown only to identify the organization; no partnership or endorsement is implied.

name: World Bank Group
summary: An international financial institution owned by its member countries. Its open data programme publishes the World Development Indicators, which eport uses for country-level trade and economic indicators.

logo.note: Logo as published on the organization's own website. A trademark of its owner, shown only to identify the organization; no partnership or endorsement is implied.

name: International Organization for Standardization
summary: An independent, non-governmental international organization whose members are national standards bodies. It publishes voluntary international standards, including the country, currency and freight-container standards used throughout trade.

logo.note: Logo as published on the organization's own website. A trademark of its owner, shown only to identify the organization; no partnership or endorsement is implied.

name: International Plant Protection Convention
summary: An intergovernmental plant health treaty whose Secretariat is hosted by FAO. Its governing body adopts International Standards for Phytosanitary Measures (ISPMs), including ISPM 15 on wood packaging material.

relations.note: The IPPC Secretariat is hosted by FAO.

logo.note: Logo as published on the organization's own website. A trademark of its owner, shown only to identify the organization; no partnership or endorsement is implied.

name: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations
summary: The United Nations specialized agency for food and agriculture. Together with the World Health Organization it runs the Codex Alimentarius Commission, whose food standards are a reference point for international food trade.

logo.note: Logo as published on the organization's own website. A trademark of its owner, shown only to identify the organization; no partnership or endorsement is implied.
